#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

ll fact[400001], revFact[400001];

ll mod_plus(ll x, ll y) {
    ll res = x + y;
    if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
    return res;
}

ll mod_sub(ll x, ll y) {
    ll res = x - y;
    if (res < 0) res += MOD;
    return res;
}

ll mod_mul(ll x, ll y) {
    return (x * y) % MOD;
}

ll mod_pow(ll x, ll y) {
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (y % 2 == 1)
        return mod_mul(x, mod_pow(x, y - 1));
    ll root = mod_pow(x, y / 2);
    return mod_mul(root, root);
}

ll mod_div(ll x, ll y) {
    return mod_mul(x, mod_pow(y, MOD - 2));
}

void preFact(int n) {
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i + 1] = mod_mul(i + 1, fact[i]);
    }
    revFact[n] = mod_div(1, fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = mod_mul(revFact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

ll cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0;
    ll af = fact[a];
    ll bf = revFact[b];
    ll abf = revFact[a - b];
    return mod_mul(mod_mul(af, bf), abf);
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    ll tmp;
    cin >> n >> tmp;
    if (n <= tmp) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    ll ans = 0;
    int si = 1;
    ll t = cmb(n, n - k);
    for (int i = n - k; i >= 1; i--) {
        ans = mod_plus(ans, mod_mul(si, mod_mul(cmb(n - k, i), mod_pow(i, n))));
        si = -si;
    }
    ans = mod_mul(ans, t);
    if (k != 0) ans = mod_mul(ans, 2);
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
